# Real pg_get_indexdef output from PostgreSQL 18.4 (postgres:18 Docker
# image), one index per line, for this schema:
#
#   CREATE TABLE public.orders (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, email text UNIQUE,
#     a int, b int, c int, d int, e int,
#     CONSTRAINT orders_a_b_key UNIQUE (a, b));
#   CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_c_idx ON public.orders (c) INCLUDE (d) WHERE e > 0;
#   CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_d_nnd_idx ON public.orders (d) NULLS NOT DISTINCT;
#   CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_e_desc_idx ON public.orders (e DESC NULLS LAST);
#
#   SELECT pg_get_indexdef(indexrelid) FROM pg_index
#   WHERE indrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass ORDER BY indexrelid::regclass::text;
#
# The last line is a deferrable constraint on a second table:
#
#   CREATE TABLE d (a int, CONSTRAINT d_a_key UNIQUE (a) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);
#   SELECT pg_get_indexdef('d_a_key'::regclass);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_a_b_key ON public.orders USING btree (a, b)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_c_idx ON public.orders USING btree (c) INCLUDE (d) WHERE (e > 0)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_d_nnd_idx ON public.orders USING btree (d) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_e_desc_idx ON public.orders USING btree (e DESC NULLS LAST)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_email_key ON public.orders USING btree (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON public.orders USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX d_a_key ON public.d USING btree (a)
